limitations: DEBUG alters scheduling; thread IDs are not priorities.
The observer logs before queue submission; allocation warnings are absent, but the low-level send return is not logged.

Release-entry pairing requires caller C038C228; later error cleanup can reuse a slot without an event5 success. RAW-free log precedes its allocator call; release-entry is not a descriptor-pool-return trace. Standby pool readback is separate evidence.
Delays whose completion arrives after vbuf include stop/drain behavior.
These are earlier SD trials, not the later H2 SSD trials.
